dimensions.assessment: Affects the Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe, the U.S. Forest Service, the Bureau of Indian Affairs, and local residents in Cass County, Minnesota.
dimensions.evidence: for the benefit of the Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe

dimensions.assessment: Involves real property transfers of federal forest land and acre-for-acre substitutions while protecting non-tribal hunting and fishing rights.
dimensions.evidence: transfer for the benefit of the tribe land in the Chippewa National Forest

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state specific monetary appropriations or fiscal costs for the land transfers and surveys.
Amends an existing tribal reservation restoration act to include additional federal land transfer criteria and rolling transfer mechanisms.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe Reservation Restoration Act to provide for the transfer of additional Federal land

dimensions.assessment: Permanent transfer of land titles and long-term rolling transfer provisions executed through administrative actions.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may transfer land to the Secretary of the Interior on a rolling basis

missing_information: Total acreage and exact financial value of the lands to be transferred are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the transfer of specific federal forest lands to the Department of the Interior for the benefit of the Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe, with acre-for-acre substitutions and public engagement.
